description:
Start from a small showroom and build your way up to a thriving car dealership empire! Buy, sell, and trade a variety of vehicles, from everyday rides to luxury sports cars, while managing inventory, pricing, and customer satisfaction. 

Expand your lot, customize your showroom, and unlock exclusive car brands to attract high-paying buyers. 
Negotiate the best deals, offer special promotions, and create the ultimate car-buying experience. 

Every decision shapes your success - can you rise to the top and become the ultimate car dealer?
name: Car Dealership Business Simulator
intro: Build, sell, and drive your way to success!
